Definition: to add or augment (often adverbial, to continue to do a thing)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to add, increase, do again; 1a) (Qal) to add, increase, do again; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to join, join oneself to; 1b2) to be joined, be added to; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to cause to add, increase; 1c2) to do more, do again
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
